title: Earliest memory: hearing his father at the Buffaloes Club
summary: Dutre first heard his father play at a neighborhood club called the Buffaloes Club, though he cannot name the band.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Uptown. Can you tell us the earliest music you remember? Was it in your home? Do you remember hearing your father play in practice? Anything that you can think of about your father, we'll talk about.
I was quite a while back. I was a kid. And they used to have a club in the neighborhood where I was staying. It's called the Buffaloes Club. And I heard my father play there for the first time.
Yes, Uptown 17-Watt. And as for the band, I really couldn't say the band because I was very smart.
